# Keith Koki — Executive Portfolio
# Product Management · Software Engineering · AI Governance Advisory

## About
Keith Koki is a product-led CTO and ISO/IEC 42001 certified AI governance advisor based in Nairobi, Kenya, operating globally (Tokyo, San Francisco, London, Remote).

## Core Expertise
- **Product Management**: B2B product strategy & discovery, outcome roadmaps, UX vision & design architecture, metrics/KPIs & growth orchestration
- **Software Engineering**: Modern frontend (Next.js, TypeScript, React), pragmatic backend systems design, technical delegation & mentorship, engineering squad velocity optimization
- **AI Governance & Advisory**: ISO/IEC 42001 algorithmic safety, responsible AI advisory for startups, algorithmic risk auditing & bias testing, automated governance & drift observability

## Current Roles
- CTO @ Qavaeat — Product Engineering & Roadmap Leadership
- CTO @ Mama Sure — Tech Team Leadership, Design, Product & Scaling
- Certified ISO/IEC 42001 Lead Assessor — Algorithmic Safety & AI Governance

## Engagement Model
- Fractional CTO & Product Advisory Retainers
